thread:
Anna (PM): quick sync — we need a compact canary plan for the Observability surface. customers want dashboards + per-route cost + lightweight tracing hooks. keep it minimal.
Kevin (SRE): agree. call it a 'mini-canary' — limit footprint: sampling steering + 1% canary traffic initially. gate on cost and 95th latency.
Matt (Eng): propose phases but compressed: Mini Phase = dashboards (errors/latency) + cost-card estimate + route tags. Canary Phase = stepped sampling + trace links for errors. Post-canary = full per-route cost reconciliation.
Leah (Product Ops): acme and two pilot customers asked for a visible per-request cost in the UI before enabling on prod. they want a short walkthrough and acceptance checklist.
Sofia (Data Eng): we can emit a route_tag at tokenization which allows per-route joins. overhead estimate ~1.5% ingest. need sign-off from runtime.
Matt (Eng): runtime ok with a small header tag, but we add config flag to opt-in per-tenant. default off for everyone until pilot.
Kevin (SRE): monitoring gates for canary: 1) error rate delta <= +15% vs baseline; 2) 95th latency delta <= +40ms; 3) estimated per-request cost delta <= +12% predicted. if any breach, auto-roll back.
Leah (Product Ops): add customer-facing acceptance: sample dashboard screenshot + acceptance answers: "does the per-route 95th match your internal SLO?". that's gating for acme.
Anna (PM): minimal acceptance criteria for Mini Phase: dashboards with median and p95, cost-card estimate column, 14-day retention, onboarding doc + short walkthrough. ok?
Matt (Eng): ok. implementation notes: cost-card will be an hourly estimate (tokens * model_rate) computed in an aggregator job — approximate for now. reconciled daily.
Sofia (Data Eng): retention plan: 14d metrics, traces only for sampled hot paths (configurable), reconcile mode for billing joins after 24h.
Kevin (SRE): operational limits: batch trace writes every 2s, max concurrent traces write = 64, file descriptor cap tested.
Matt (Eng): will add batching/backpressure; also a tenant toggle service for enabling per-route cost and tracing hooks per customer.
Leah (Product Ops): timeline ask: can we do Mini Phase in 3 weeks? customers want a pilot asap.
Matt (Eng): realistic: 3 sprints would be safer. propose sprint plan: Sprint A (2 weeks) = route tagging + dashboards; Sprint B (2 weeks) = sampling config + canary infra; Sprint C (1 week) = cost estimator + docs + walkthroughs. aim pilot end of Sprint B limited to acme and internal users.
Anna (PM): proposed gates for pilot promotion to wider beta: stable for 72h at 10% traffic with no gate breaches and billing estimate within 15% of baseline.
Sofia (Data Eng): sampling config snippet we plan to land:
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.03
  error_traces: 1.0
  hot_routes: 1.0
  max_concurrent_writes: 64
  flush_interval_ms: 2000
```
Kevin (SRE): plus rollout steps: 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 10% with 24h observation windows.
Leah (Product Ops): I'll own the acceptance template and schedule acme walkthrough for the pilot window. need PRs for screenshots.
Matt (Eng): I'll own runtime PRs and the aggregator job. will send batching PR by Thursday EOD.
Sofia (Data Eng): I'll open schema PR for cost joins and a small backfill test. due next Tue.
Kevin (SRE): I'll craft the ops-runbook: rollback playbook, monitoring panels, pager list, runbook test steps. due before canary.
ops-bot: reminder: obs-playbook template updated — https://redwood/internal/obs-playbook-template :pushpin:

Any immediate blockers?
